component.name: Null Notes
component.summary: Your notes as plain files: linked, searchable, encrypted, synced

description.p: Null Notes is a local-first Markdown notes app. A vault is just a folder on your computer: no account, no cloud, and nothing leaves the machine unless you turn on sync. It is part of Null Grid, alongside Null Search and Null Drive.

ul.li: Markdown with a live preview: tasks, tables, code, images and Mermaid diagrams
Wiki links, tags, backlinks and an outline; links update when you rename a note
Canvases (whiteboards in the JSON Canvas format) and a graph view
Quick open, full-text search, daily notes and templates
Locked notes, encrypted with XChaCha20-Poly1305 and an Argon2id key
Backup or two-way sync with Null Drive, your own file server, including end-to-end encrypted accounts
Null Search integration and nullnotes:// links

screenshot.caption: The editor, with live preview, backlinks and outline
The graph of how notes connect

description.p: Linux packages for more distros: AppImage, .rpm, .tar.gz, Flatpak and Snap, on x86_64 and ARM64.
Backup and two-way sync into end-to-end encrypted Null Drive accounts.
